query:
SELECT
            COUNT(*)                                        AS total_items,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'done')  AS done_items,
            COALESCE(SUM(story_points), 0)                 AS total_points,
            COALESCE(SUM(story_points) FILTER (WHERE status::text = 'done'), 0) AS done_points
        FROM work_items
        WHERE epic_id = $1
